search_results.title: Gene Therapy Shows Durable Results In Small Trial
search_results.snippet: A small clinical trial reported that a one-time gene therapy's benefits persisted three years after treatment in most participants.

search_results.title: Biotech Startup Raises Round For Protein Design Platform
search_results.snippet: A startup building an AI-assisted protein design platform closed a new funding round to expand its wet-lab validation pipeline.

search_results.title: Regulator Approves Faster Pathway For Rare Disease Drugs
search_results.snippet: A health regulator approved a faster review pathway for drugs targeting rare diseases with very small patient populations.

search_results.title: Lab-Grown Tissue Model Improves Drug Screening
search_results.snippet: Researchers described a lab-grown tissue model that better predicts how candidate drugs behave in human organs before clinical trials.
